purpose: Real-iPad QA of the zoom-trap fix (layers 1-2) and the mosaic fill safety (exterior non-fillable mask + tiny-pocket no-op). Production stays at little-color-garden-v19.
stagedFrom: agent/zcode-mosaic-stalecache, coloring-app per that branch (ship set minus service-worker.js)
serviceWorker: Stripped per scripts/testhub-service-worker.py: a staged copy must carry no worker, because /test-apps/ and the live app share one origin and one CacheStorage.
whyR3: The r2 refresh at /test-apps/coloring-pinch-pilot/ carried the same fixes, but the owner's iPad QA (17:5x ICT) still saw the old fill behaviour while reporting the zoom fix present — the signature of Safari serving the deploy-1 app.js from cache (Pages sends max-age=600 and iOS Safari revalidates unreliably on reload). WebKit probes on all nine sheets and a full-UI WebKit run found zero leak paths in the fixed code (cells identical to PIL ground truth, 0 painted px outside the art), so the fix itself was never in question. r3 is the same code under URLs no cache has ever seen, plus a visible build tag: if the badge says 'staging r3 - 19 Sep 2026', the bytes are fresh.
buildTag: staging r3 - 19 Sep 2026, fixed top-right, pointer-events:none, staging-only markup that never exists in coloring-app/
fillHarness: coloring-app/tools/check-mosaic-fill.py (runs in preflight; CI installs Pillow for it)
